description: This PHP source file defines the 'Country' model class within the Opencart system, responsible for managing country data in the localisation module. It includes methods for creating, reading, updating, and deleting country records, as well as handling descriptions in multiple languages.

classes.name: Country
classes.description: Model class responsible for handling country data, including CRUD operations and multilingual descriptions within the Opencart localisation module.

methods.name: addCountry
methods.description: Creates a new country record in the database using provided data, including descriptions in multiple languages.

methods.name: editCountry
methods.description: Updates an existing country record identified by country_id with new data and descriptions.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Changes the active/inactive status of a specified country.

methods.name: deleteCountry
methods.description: Removes a country record and its descriptions from the database.

methods.name: getCountry
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information of a country by its ID.

methods.name: getCountryByIsoCode2
methods.description: Fetches country details based on ISO 2-character code.

methods.name: getCountryByIsoCode3
methods.description: Fetches country details based on ISO 3-character code.

methods.name: getCountries
methods.description: Retrieves a list of countries, optionally filtered and sorted according to provided criteria.

methods.name: getTotalCountries
methods.description: Returns the count of country records matching optional filters.

methods.name: getTotalCountriesByAddressFormatId
methods.description: Counts how many countries have a specific address format ID.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for a country in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions associated with a specific country.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Removes all descriptions available in a particular language.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Fetches description details for a country in a specific language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a country across languages.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all country descriptions available in a specific language.
